100% after-sales service: complete accessories - Stand×1、Power Bank×1、TYPE-C Power Cable×1、TYPE-C Charger Cable×1、Storage Bag×1. Offering a 12-month warranty and 100% after-sales service, if it doesn't fit your Starlink Mini, please contact us - we'll replace it for free.
